C0405.title: Credentials Still the 'Achilles' Heel'? Cisco's Latest Report Reveals New Threats from Old Attack Patterns
C0405.summary: Cisco's 2025 Global Threat Landscape Report indicates that over 60% of initial intrusions originate from stolen login credentials. Attackers exploit password reuse habits through credential stuffing or obtain credentials via phishing.
